messages.text: BL-2084 🎵 in progress — The tuning report's --briefing mode prints, for each local-model seat with a settings record, one markdown table row per day over the last 7 days (requests, time to first token, prefill and decode speed, output, thinking share, compressions per 10 requests, tool-call failure rate), or the single line that no local-model seat ran - the table half of BL-1854's Local LLM briefing section
